why_no_wire_level_product_holdout.finding: Product FEC actuation is POLICY-ONLY: there is no product send-path FEC encoder (a decode path exists but is default-OFF and unreachable from any product sender). The fusion ARQ output is also inert — arq.plan uses arq_aggressiveness_permille only as an ==0 gate and the fixture guarantees >=200.
why_no_wire_level_product_holdout.consequence: A wire-level product holdout comparing calibrated-ON vs OFF would be BYTE-IDENTICAL in every run and would measure nothing. Executing one would manufacture the appearance of product validation without any product effect.
why_no_wire_level_product_holdout.decision: Run a GROUPED DECISION-REPLAY HOLDOUT instead, and cap the verdict at CALIBRATION-GO — EXPERIMENTAL/LIMITED. A wire-level product holdout becomes meaningful only after a real product FEC actuator exists.

holdout_design.type: grouped decision-replay holdout over authoritative cells
holdout_design.grouping_unit: cell_id (which carries its seed lineage); row-random splitting is FORBIDDEN
holdout_design.split_rule: GROUP-DISJOINT BY RTT STRATUM. TRAIN = every cell whose configured RTT is 50 ms or 250 ms. HOLDOUT = every cell whose configured RTT is 1000 ms. No cell, seed lineage or pairing group appears on both sides.
holdout_design.training_use: the calibrated loss boundary is RE-DERIVED from TRAIN cells only, then evaluated on HOLDOUT cells
holdout_design.retuning_on_holdout: FORBIDDEN — a valid holdout failure is reported honestly as LIMITED/NO-GO

pre_specified_acceptance_criteria.primary_safety_criterion: ZERO HARMFUL FALSE-POSITIVE FEC recommendations on held-out cells. A harmful false positive is a held-out cell where the policy recommends FecAssist but the Pareto analysis prefers an ARQ action (i.e. the recommendation would add cost without a completion benefit).
pre_specified_acceptance_criteria.secondary_sensitivity: the policy SHOULD recommend FecAssist on held-out cells whose Pareto-preferred action is FEC_R2. Missing such a cell is a FALSE NEGATIVE.

verdict_mapping.CALIBRATION-GO — EXPERIMENTAL/LIMITED: zero harmful false positives AND no safety/invariant failure. False negatives are permitted and reported (conservative behaviour is safe).
verdict_mapping.CALIBRATION-NO-GO: any harmful false positive, any safety/invariant failure, any unbounded cost, any leakage, or any dependence on a runtime-unobservable feature.
verdict_mapping.CALIBRATION-GO — PRODUCT-VALIDATED: UNREACHABLE this turn — requires a real product FEC actuator and a faithful wire-level holdout.

pre_specified_acceptance_criteria.note: No accuracy percentage threshold is invented. The criterion is asymmetric and safety-grounded: false positives (harmful) are disqualifying, false negatives (conservative) are not.

metrics_reported: per-held-out-cell: Pareto-preferred action, policy recommendation, match/false-positive/false-negative
oracle regret (completion and wire) of following the policy vs the per-cell hindsight optimum
